text: Final composed-map inverse admission now recomputes and gates actual endpoints, with explicit image-derived regions and coverage checks. Accumulated world-displacement smoothing is optional per level. Initial five-pair development passes all checks with total smoothing 1.5 mm, improving Dice 0.404180 to 0.419023; four cases stop at 20 coarse / 0 fine updates. The prospectively frozen 1.5 mm coarse / 0.75 mm fine follow-up reaches 40 on all five but passes all checks only 3/5: anatomy fails on OASIS 11-to-12; endpoint admission correctly rejects 0.207926 mm on OASIS 13-to-14. Fresh selected refinement passes 4/5 declared pairs versus conservative 4/5, with one upstream affine skip. Mean Dice on available maps is 0.407682 versus 0.395898. Keep the issue open for fine-stage controller exhaustion and higher-accuracy exportable updates; next work should examine regularization consistent with step backtracking and use new confirmation data.
